chestcloth that so much learned of her flesh.

rows.jp: すでに体温の失われたそれを介して呼吸をする時、仄かな少女の%Nスメルは私をまたたくまに幻想的な幻想へと連れ去るのであっ%Nた。
rows.en: Though it had lost her warmth, breathing through it let the faint%NSMELL of a girl sweep me away at once into a fantastical%Nfantasy.

ghs.en:
On the moment of a respiratory act through the
item already parting with that warmth by body
induced, the faint subodorare of young woman in
an instant whisks me into a delusional world of
delusional delusion.
~FIN~

rows.jp: ～ＦＩＮ～
rows.en: ~FIN~

rows.jp: 間違いなく通常時の俺ノリだ。
rows.en: No question: this is how I sound on an ordinary day.

ghs.en: That unmistakable style I have in normal times.

rows.jp: けどおかしいじゃないか。
rows.en: But that makes no sense.

ghs.en: But isn't this weird?

rows.jp: 俺が書いた日記なら、記憶に残っているはずなのに。
rows.en: If I wrote this diary, I should remember it.

ghs.en: Should this diary be my writing, recollections of it are yet expected to have remained.

rows.jp: 確かにたまに書いてはいたけど……。
rows.en: I have written entries from time to time, admittedly...

ghs.en: Certainly I occasionally write in it but...
Taichi: "...no, this is different."

rows.jp: まったく記憶にない。
rows.en: I remembered none of it.

ghs.en: There are no memories whatsoever.

rows.jp: ここに書かれている内容は、記憶にはない出来事。
rows.en: These entries describe events I don’t remember.

ghs.en: What is written in here are events that are not in my memory.

rows.jp: ちなみに記憶喪失でもない。
rows.en: And I’m not suffering from amnesia, either.

ghs.en: However, this is not memory loss either.

rows.jp: むしろいらんことまで覚えているタイプだ。
rows.en: If anything, I’m the sort who remembers things better left forgotten.

ghs.en: Rather, I'm the type that even remembers the worthless.

rows.jp: 幼馴染みと結婚の約束でもしようものなら、将来固ゆでジョブに就いた挙げ句に敵の手にかかり自白剤をブチ込まれて廃人になったとしても
rows.en: I could promise my childhood friend we would marry, take up a hard-boiled profession years later, fall into enemy hands, get pumped full of truth serum, and wind up a vegetable—

ghs.en: {}Even were I, in the tough-simmered job I will eventually have, fall in the hands of the enemy and be turned into an invalid due to truth serum injections, I would never forget things even as small as the marriage promise to a childhood friend, for that is how much of a Memory Hunter I am.

rows.jp: そのことだけは決して忘れることのないくらいに思い出ハンターでもある。
rows.en: and I would still remember that promise. That was the kind of memory hunter I was.

rows.jp: ま、記憶力は良い方だ。
rows.en: In short, my memory is good.

ghs.en: Well, my memory skills are good ones.

rows.jp: 記憶してないことと言えば……それこそ出産の場面くらいのものさ。
rows.en: About the only thing I don’t remember is my own birth.

ghs.en: Things I don't have recollections of... I'd say there's the moment of my birth.

rows.jp: 「わはは（米笑）」
rows.en: “Wahaha! (Amerilaugh)”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Wahahah (ULOL)"

rows.jp: すでに滅亡した米国人が喜びそうなセンスだった。
rows.en: The sort of humor the now-extinct Americans would have loved.

ghs.en: In that sense in which the already fallen Americans would be pleased with.

rows.jp: さて。
rows.en: Now then.

ghs.en: Well then,

rows.jp: 読み進める。
rows.en: I read on.

ghs.en: I continue reading.

rows.jp: 水曜日。
rows.en: Wednesday

ghs.en: Wednesday.

rows.jp: ふむ。次。
rows.en: Hm. Next.

ghs.en: Hm. Next.

rows.jp: 木曜日。
rows.en: Thursday

ghs.en: Thursday.

rows.jp: そして金曜日。
rows.en: And then Friday.

ghs.en: And then, Friday.

rows.jp: 今日は海に行った。%N去年はみんなで行った海。%N今年はずいぶんと、寂しいことになった。
rows.en: Went to the beach today.%NThe same beach we all visited last year.%NThis year, it was terribly lonely.

ghs.en:
Last year we had gone to the beach with everybody.
This year, it turned into something really lonesome.

rows.jp: ぎこちなかったけれど、互いに築きあげると信じて、触れあおうとした去年。
rows.en: Last year had been awkward, but we believed we could build something together, and we tried to reach one another.

ghs.en: It was awkward, but I believe there was reciprocal accumulation of enrichment, as well as attempts to touch each other in that last year.

rows.jp: 楽しかった頃ばかりが思い出された。%Nあれからたったの一年で、俺たちは疎遠になってしまった。%N互いに対する関心を失ってしまった。
rows.en: All I could remember were the happy times.%NIn a single year, we had grown apart.%NWe had lost interest in one another.

ghs.en:
I was reminded of those times of nothing but fun.
In one single year since then, we had become completely estranged.
That respective reciprocal interest was wholly lost.
It's because of all the things that have happened.

rows.jp: いろいろなことがあったせいだ。
rows.en: A great many things had happened.

rows.jp: けど、理由はそれだけじゃない。
rows.en: But that was not the only reason.

ghs.en: But the reason is not only in that.

rows.jp: ……俺たちの心にも、問題があったんだ。
rows.en: ...There was something wrong in us as well.

ghs.en: ...there were problems inside our hearts, as well.

rows.jp: そして今、世界には俺たちのみがいる。%Nこの皮肉に満ちた構図は、なんなのだろう。
rows.en: And now we alone remained in the world.%NWhat was I to make of that bitterly ironic arrangement?

ghs.en: And now, in the world there is us and nothing else. What to even think about a composition so full of irony.

rows.jp: 夜、見里先輩の様子を見に行った。
rows.en: That night, I went to check on Misato.

ghs.en: At night, I went to see what Misato-senpai was doing.

rows.jp: ついでに、例の七香という少女の言葉を思いだし、祠を見に行った。
rows.en: While I was out, I remembered what that girl Nanaka had said and went to see the shrine.

ghs.en: Incidentally, I remembered the words of this girl named Nanaka, and went to look at the hokora.

rows.jp: 俺は夜の方が行動しやすい。%N変な体質だ。
rows.en: I find it easier to act at night.%NA peculiar constitution.

ghs.en: I find it easy to act at night. It's a weird genetic make-up.

rows.jp: いろいろと疑問はある。%Nけど思考はまとまらない。%N七香の意味深な示唆に反して、祠から異変は見受けられなかった。
rows.en: There were any number of questions.%NBut my thoughts refused to come together.%NDespite Nanaka’s loaded hints, nothing at the shrine appeared unusual.

ghs.en:
There are so many questions, but thoughts will not come to a point.
Contrary to Nanaka's pregnant suggestion, at the hokora I did not catch sight of anything abnormal.

rows.jp: ただ、一枚の紙片がそこにはあった。%N曜子ちゃんのメモだった。%N真新しいメモだ。
rows.en: There was only a single scrap of paper.%NA note from Youko.%NFreshly written.

ghs.en:
All that was there was one single scrap of paper.
It was a note by Youko-chan.
A brand new note.

rows.jp: 『全ての記録をここに保存しなさい』
rows.en: “Preserve every record here.”

ghs.en: 『Please save all your records here.』

rows.jp: いつものことながら、理由の説明はない。
rows.en: As usual, she offered no explanation.

ghs.en: As it's always the thing with her, no explanation for the reason why.

rows.jp: 彼女はあまりにも完成度の高い人間であるため、他者との意思疎通を必要としない。
rows.en: Youko is so perfectly self-contained that she has no need to communicate with anyone else.

rows.jp: そのため口べたで、寡黙で、余分な言葉をはぶく傾向がある。%Nはぶきすぎて、わけのわからないことも多い。
rows.en: That makes her inarticulate, taciturn, and inclined to omit unnecessary words.%NShe omits so many that much of what she says is incomprehensible.

ghs.en:
Because she is a human with an excessively high degree of perfection, she finds it unnecessary to come to a mutual understanding with others. Because of that, she has a tendency of being tongue-tied, uncommunicative, and to omit extraneous words.
Frequently she omits excessively, so that I don't get her at all.

rows.jp: けど、彼女が言うことに間違いはない。%Nそうすべきなのだろう。%N俺は自宅に戻り、今日までの日記を持ってくることにした。
rows.en: But what Youko says is never wrong.%NI supposed I should do as instructed.%NI decided to return home and bring back the diary I had kept through today.

ghs.en: And so I returned home and brought with the diary I had written until today.

rows.jp: だから日記は、これが最後になる。
rows.en: So this will be my final entry.

ghs.en: Therefore the diary has its conclusion here.

rows.jp: 一冊目はこれで終わりだ。
rows.en: That’s the end of the first notebook.

ghs.en: This is how volume one ends.

rows.jp: 二冊目。
rows.en: Notebook two.

ghs.en: Volume two.

rows.jp: 内容はほぼ一緒だ。
rows.en: Its contents are almost identical.

ghs.en: Contents are nearly one and the same.

rows.jp: 月曜からの何気ない日々。
rows.en: The same ordinary days, beginning on Monday.

ghs.en: Casual days from Monday onwards,

rows.jp: そして土曜に祠に。
rows.en: Then a visit to the shrine on Saturday.

ghs.en: then in the hokora on Saturday.

rows.jp: 三冊目。四冊目。五冊目。
rows.en: Three. Four. Five.

ghs.en: Volume three. Volume four. Volume five.

rows.jp: それが繰り返されている。
rows.en: The pattern repeats.

ghs.en: That repeats all over again.

rows.jp: 内容は、違うこともあった。
rows.en: Some details differ.

ghs.en: There were differences in the contents still.

rows.jp: たとえばFLOWER'Sと出会うタイミングが違っていたり、みみ先輩と冬子への対応が違っていたり。
rows.en: Sometimes I meet FLOWER’S at a different point, or respond differently to Mimi and Touko.

ghs.en: For example the timing of the meeting with the Flowers was different, and the interactions with Mimi-senpai and Touko were different.

rows.jp: けど大まかには、同じ一週間を繰り返しなぞっているようだ。
rows.en: Broadly, though, every notebook traces the same week again.

ghs.en: But in rough terms, contents appear to be traced over the exact same reiterated week.

rows.jp: まるで、同じ時間を幾度もやり直したような……。
rows.en: As though I’ve lived the same span of time again and again...

ghs.en: Just as if the exact same period of time was being repeated countless times...

rows.jp: 冷静に考えると、この日記が示す可能性はいくつかある。
rows.en: Considered calmly, the diaries suggest several possibilities.

ghs.en: Thinking composedly, there are several possibilities indicated by these diaries.

rows.jp: ①俺にもう一つの人格があって、勝手に書いた
rows.en: 1. I have another personality that wrote them without my knowledge.

ghs.en:
1) There is one more personality in me that
is writing on its own;

rows.jp: ②未来の俺が書いたものがここに来ている
rows.en: 2. Something written by my future self has found its way here.

ghs.en:
2) Something written by a future me has ended
up here;

rows.jp: ③同じ時間を繰り返している
rows.en: 3. I am repeating the same span of time.

ghs.en:
3) The same period of time is repeating over
and over.

rows.jp: ①はない。保証する。
rows.en: Option 1 is out. I guarantee it.

ghs.en: Number 1) isn't it. Guaranteed.

rows.jp: 猿にタイプライターを与えても、偶然シェイクスピアを書き上げることはないからだ。
rows.en: Even if you gave a monkey a typewriter, it would never accidentally produce Shakespeare.

ghs.en: Because there is no such thing as giving typewriters to monkeys and them writing out Shakespeare by accident.

rows.jp: ②も常識的に考えてまずないだろう。
rows.en: Common sense rules out option 2 as well.

ghs.en: Number 2), to common sense, also appears unlikely.

rows.en: That left option 3—

ghs.en: Number 3)---

rows.jp: 少なくとも、この五冊の日記が示しているのは、この可能性だった。
rows.en: At least, that’s the possibility these five diaries point to.

ghs.en: At the very least, what these five diaries indicate is this possibility.

rows.jp: 件のメモは、一冊目のノートに挟まれていた。
rows.en: The note in question had been tucked into the first notebook.

ghs.en: The aforementioned note was held inside the first notebook.

rows.jp: ひどく古いメモだった。
rows.en: It is extremely old.

ghs.en: It was a hideously old note.

rows.jp: 何年も前に書いたもののように思える。
rows.en: It looked years old.

ghs.en: It appears to be something that has been written so many years ago.

rows.jp: 全ての記録を……か。
rows.en: Every record...

ghs.en: All your records... then.

rows.jp: まあ日記のことだろうな。
rows.en: She must have meant the diaries.

ghs.en: I guess it means the diaries.

rows.jp: さて、なぜそうしなければならないか。
rows.en: The question was why they had to be kept.

ghs.en: Still, why do I really need to do so?

rows.jp: 日記には基本的に金曜日以降の記録はない。
rows.en: As a rule, the entries stop at Friday.

ghs.en: Fundamentally, there is no record in the diaries beyond Friday.

rows.jp: 四冊目は例外的に土曜日まで続いていたが。
rows.en: The fourth notebook is the lone exception, continuing through Saturday.

ghs.en: Volume Four, exceptionally, continues up to Saturday.

rows.jp: これはつまり、土曜以降になにかが起こり、また最初からやり直しを強いられているということになる。
rows.en: That means something happens on Saturday or afterward and forces everything to begin again from the start.

ghs.en: This, in other words, means that something happens after Saturday, and all is compulsively redone from the beginning once more.

rows.jp: 再スタート地点は月曜だろうか。日曜という可能性もある。
rows.en: Is Monday the restart point? Sunday is also possible.

ghs.en: Restart point might be Monday. Sunday is another possibility.

rows.jp: 日曜は気が滅入って、日記をつけなかったからだ。
rows.en: I had been too depressed to write on Sunday.

ghs.en: Because Sunday I was feeling depressed and did not keep the diary.

rows.jp: おそらく多くの可能性で、同じ行動を俺は取るだろう。
rows.en: In most possible timelines, I’ll probably make the same choices.

ghs.en: Perhaps, among these many possibilities, I would keep taking the same actions.

rows.jp: いや、待てよ。
rows.en: No. Wait.

ghs.en: No, wait a second.

rows.jp: 「世界が繰り返しているだって？」
rows.en: “The world is repeating itself?”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Am I saying the world is repeating?"

rows.jp: 突拍子もないことだ。
rows.en: Absurd.

ghs.en: That is astonishingly ridiculous.

rows.jp: けど、今のところ……。
rows.en: But for now...

ghs.en: But, what we have here right now...

rows.jp: 結論を出すのはよそう。
rows.en: I’ll hold off on a conclusion.

ghs.en: Let's not put the final word to this.

rows.jp: 結論は終着点からの回想。
rows.en: A conclusion is a backward glance from the journey’s end.

ghs.en: The final word is a reflection from the final destination,

rows.jp: 至る過程における判断の過程でしかない。
rows.en: Anything before that is only one step in the reasoning that gets me there.

ghs.en: and the process of reaching it is inevitably the process of a judgment.

rows.jp: ここでは、俺が……いや世界が、同じ一週間を延々とループさせている可能性が高い。
rows.en: For now, I’ll assume it’s not me but the world that’s looping endlessly through the same week.

ghs.en: For what's here, the possibility that I... no, that the world is repeating the same one week period in an endless loop is high.

rows.jp: と考えておこう。
rows.en: That will do for now.

ghs.en: And that is where the thoughts stay.

rows.jp: ループにはルールがあるらしい。
rows.en: The loop seems to have rules.

ghs.en: In this loop there seems to be a rule.

rows.jp: それは……主観記憶の削除。
rows.en: One is the deletion of subjective memory.

ghs.en: That is... the erasure of subjective memories.

rows.jp: 日記が途絶えて以降、少なくとも世界は五回以上は『巻き戻っている』はずだ。
rows.en: Since the diaries broke off, the world must have ‘rewound’ at least five times.

ghs.en: Since the diaries stop at that, it is expectable that there have been at the very least five instances or more in which the world has been 'wound back'.

rows.jp: 同時に、俺の記憶も完全に巻き戻されている。
rows.en: At the same time, my memory had been rewound completely.

ghs.en: At the same time, my memories are thoroughly and flawlessly wound back as well.

rows.jp: これは断定できた。
rows.en: That much is certain.

ghs.en: This I've settled.

rows.jp: 俺の記憶に欠損や不明瞭な部分はない。
rows.en: There are no gaps or blurred patches in my memory.

ghs.en: No part of my memory is damaged or unintelligible.

rows.jp: 曜子ちゃんはさすがくのいちで、早々にこの事実に気がついた。
rows.en: True ninja that she is, Youko spotted this early.

ghs.en: Youko-chan, expectably of a Kunoichi, promptly became aware of this fact,

rows.jp: そして俺に対してメモを残した。
rows.en: And left me a note.

ghs.en: and then left a note behind for my sake.

rows.jp: なぜか。
rows.en: Why?

ghs.en: For what reason?

rows.jp: つまり曜子ちゃんも、巻き戻りとともに記憶を失うから―――
rows.en: Because Youko, too, must lose her memory whenever the world rewinds—

ghs.en: Because in the end, even Youko-chan loses all her memories in the rewinding---

rows.jp: ひいては、他のメンツも同様だと思われた。
rows.en: which means the others probably do too.

ghs.en: Therefore, the rest of the team appears to be in the same situation.

rows.jp: みみ先輩、冬子、美希と霧、桜庭、友貴……。
rows.en: Mimi, Touko, Miki and Kiri, Sakuraba, Tomoki...

ghs.en: Mimi-senpai, Touko, Miki and Kiri, Sakuraba, Tomoki...

rows.jp: 「そうか」
rows.en: “I see.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Indeed."

rows.jp: 現状の厄介さがわかってきた。
rows.en: I’m beginning to grasp how troublesome our situation is.

ghs.en: I understood the difficulty of the present situation.

rows.jp: 記憶がリセットされる。
rows.en: Our memories reset.

ghs.en: Memories are reset.

rows.jp: つまり。
rows.en: Which meant—

ghs.en: In other words,

rows.jp: 今こうして真相にたどりついた記憶も、週末にはリセット。
rows.en: even the memory of reaching the truth here and now would be wiped clean by the weekend.

ghs.en: these memories of at last discovering the truth of things will be reset at the end of the week as well.

rows.jp: 翌週（文字通りの）には、疑問なく月曜日を生きる俺がいるわけだ。
rows.en: The following week—literally—I would live through Monday without a single doubt.

ghs.en: In the week that (literally) follows, there will be a me living without doubts on a Monday.

rows.jp: 俺が再び真相に到達するには、偶然に導かれてこの祠に……。
rows.en: To reach the truth again, chance would have to lead me back to this shrine...

ghs.en: And I have been led to this hokora by coincidence, so that I could learn the truth once more...

rows.en: “...Oh, hell.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "...whoa."

rows.jp: 下手な鉄砲を連射しないといけない状況だな。
rows.en: I’ll have to spray and pray until one blind shot finally hits.

ghs.en: This is a state of affairs where I can only fan the revolver unskillfully and hope to still hit the target.

rows.jp: げんなりした。
rows.en: The thought alone exhausts me.

ghs.en: I felt helpless.

rows.jp: ルールはもう一つある。
rows.en: There seems to be one more rule.

ghs.en: There is one more rule.

rows.jp: それはこの祠が、どうやらループの影響を免れているということ。
rows.en: This shrine, somehow, was exempt from the loop’s effects.

ghs.en: That is, this hokora is exempted from the influence of the loop, one way or another.

rows.jp: この場所にいる限り、主観時間は保たれるわけだ。
rows.en: As long as one remained here, subjective time was preserved.

ghs.en: Within the boundaries of this location, subjective time is preserved.

rows.jp: 「……曜子ちゃん、どうやって確かめたんだろう」
rows.en: “...How did Youko ever test that?”

ghs.en: Taichi: "...Youko-chan, how did you even ascertain this?"

rows.jp: ノートがあれば理解はできる。
rows.en: With the notebooks in front of me, it’s easy enough to understand.

ghs.en: If there are notebooks, understanding is possible.

rows.jp: けど何もない状態で、いかにして祠の特異性を見抜けるのか。
rows.en: But how could anyone discover the shrine’s singular nature with nothing to guide them?

ghs.en: But in case of there wasn't anything, how is it possible to see through to the specificity of the shrine?

rows.jp: およそ常人の行動力で探求できるとは思えない。
rows.en: No ordinary person would have the drive to investigate that far.

ghs.en: It seems unlikely to be a quest within the means of an ordinary person of roughly ordinary talents.

rows.jp: もちろん彼女は常人なんて生やさしいものじゃないけれど。
rows.en: Of course, ‘ordinary’ is far too mild a word for Youko.

ghs.en: However, she of course nothing like the simple straightforward ordinary person.

rows.jp: 「曜子ちゃんなら、やるか……」
rows.en: “Youko could do it, I suppose...”

ghs.en: Taichi: "If anyone can do it, it's Youko-chan..."

rows.jp: いろいろ調査してまわっているみたいだし。
rows.en: She does seem to have been investigating all sorts of things.

ghs.en: It does seem like she is making the rounds, investigating all sorts of things.

rows.jp: 「しかし」
rows.en: “Still...”

ghs.en: Taichi: "And yet..."

rows.jp: 祠の中に入りながら、思う。
rows.en: I think as I climb into the shrine.

ghs.en: I think as I begin to enter inside the hokora.

rows.jp: 狭い。
rows.en: Cramped.

ghs.en: Cramped,

rows.jp: 変形ロボットばりに手足を折りたたまないと、侵入はかなわない。
rows.en: I have to fold my limbs like a transforming robot just to get inside.

ghs.en: that unless I folds my arms like a transforming robot, this trespass is beyond my power.

rows.jp: そもそもあの七香って女の子は、何者だ。
rows.en: And who is that girl Nanaka, anyway?

ghs.en: To begin with, this girl Nanaka - who or what is she.

rows.jp: 「うーむ」
rows.en: “Hmm.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Hmm-hm."

rows.jp: 判断材料はほとんどない。
rows.en: I had almost nothing to go on.

ghs.en: Materials for judgment are almost nonexistent.

rows.jp: 快活そうで、変わった制服を着ていて、自転車に乗って、すらりと伸びた脚、引き締まった臀部、着やせしているものの平均値は上回るバスト……。
rows.en: She seemed cheerful, wore a peculiar uniform, rode a bicycle, had long, shapely legs, a firm rear, and an above-average bust that her clothes did their best to conceal...

ghs.en: All cheerful, she wears an unusual uniform, rides a bicycle, has sleek and smooth legs, firm butt, her wholly average bust so improved in value by how good she looks in her clothes...

rows.jp: 「あっ、いかん」
rows.en: “Ah. This is bad.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Gah, cut it out."

rows.jp: 体積が増した。
rows.en: A certain part of me swells.

ghs.en: The volume has increased.

rows.jp: こんなに増したら、祠に入りにくくなってしまうじゃないか！
rows.en: At this rate, squeezing into the shrine would become even harder!

ghs.en: Won't it get harder to get in the hokora with this increase in volume?!

rows.jp: と思っていたが、すんなり入れた。
rows.en: Or so I think. I slip inside without difficulty.

ghs.en: So I thought, but I entered without difficulty.

rows.jp: 「……しくしくしく」
rows.en: “...Sob, sob, sob.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "...sob, sob, sob."

rows.jp: 入れたは入れたが、身動きはほとんど取れない。
rows.en: I’m inside, all right, but can hardly move.

ghs.en: Enter I can enter, but I can make almost no movement.

rows.jp: 自分が直方体になってしまった感覚に包まれる。
rows.en: I feel as though I’ve become a rectangular solid.

ghs.en: I am enveloped by the sensation of having become cuboid.

rows.jp: 扉を閉めてみた。
rows.en: I try closing the doors.

ghs.en: I tried closing the doors.

rows.jp: 「完成」
rows.en: “Complete.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Done."

rows.jp: 何がだ。
rows.en: Complete what?

ghs.en: But what?
